description: This file contains unit tests for the AmqpServiceBase class, verifying behaviors such as link handling, authorization, and disconnection handling within an AMQP service implementation.

classes.name: AmqpServiceBaseTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying behaviors of AmqpServiceBase.

methods.name: initMocks
methods.description: Initializes mock objects before each test.

methods.name: createServer
methods.description: Creates an instance of AmqpServiceBase with optional endpoint and disconnect handler.

methods.name: testHandleReceiverOpenForwardsToEndpoint
methods.description: Test that the server forwards accepted link attachments to the registered endpoint.

methods.name: testHandleReceiverOpenRejectsUnauthorizedClient
methods.description: Test that the server rejects links from unauthorized clients.

methods.name: testServerCallsPublishEventOnClientDisconnect
methods.description: Test that disconnecting clients trigger the event publication.
